name: @yozz.app/worker-web
description: The yozz.app Worker: the app (../web) and the landing page (../web-marketing) as static assets, and a few lines that serve / to a signed-in browser as the app, and give the landing page the one CSP addition its analytics need. VITE_API_URL is baked at build so apps/web/src/vault/api-base-url.ts sees a configured API.

scripts.deploy: VITE_API_URL=https://api.yozz.app pnpm -F @yozz.app/web build && pnpm -F @yozz.app/web-marketing build && node scripts/assemble-assets.ts && varlock run -- wrangler deploy
